# scm_security_rule_order (Resource)

Enforces the order of a named set of security rules within a single (container, rulebase). Rules present in SCM but not listed in `ordered_rules` are left in place under the default `consecutive` mode; they may be moved under `strictly_consecutive` mode to keep the block uninterrupted. Uses the `/security-rules/{id}:move` API. Manage the rules themselves with `scm_security_rule` resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ordered_rules` (List of String) Ordered list of security rule names, top-to-bottom. Rules will be arranged in this left-to-right order.
- `rulebase` (String) Rulebase to reorder. One of `pre` or `post`.

### Optional

- `destination` (String) Where the block of `ordered_rules` should anchor. One of `null`, `top`, `bottom`, `before`, `after`. `null` (default) preserves relative order without pinning an absolute position. `top` / `bottom` pin the first / last rule to the top / bottom of the rulebase. `before` / `after` pin the first / last rule immediately adjacent to `destination_rule`.
- `destination_rule` (String) Name of the anchor rule; required when `destination` is `before` or `after`. Must be a rule that exists in SCM but is NOT listed in `ordered_rules`.
- `device` (String) The device the rules belong to. Exactly one of `folder`, `snippet`, or `device` must be set.
- `folder` (String) The folder the rules belong to. Exactly one of `folder`, `snippet`, or `device` must be set.
- `order` (String) Ordering mode. `consecutive` (default) preserves the relative order of `ordered_rules` while allowing manual or third-party rules to be interleaved. `strictly_consecutive` enforces a contiguous block with no interleaving; the algorithm may issue `:move` calls on unmanaged rules to keep total move count down.
- `snippet` (String) The snippet the rules belong to. Exactly one of `folder`, `snippet`, or `device` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID: `<folder>:<snippet>:<device>:<rulebase>` (unused container slots empty), the same shape as `scm_security_rule`.


## Import

The following command can be used to import a resource not managed by Terraform:

```bash
terraform import scm_security_rule_order.example folder:::id
```

or

```bash
terraform import scm_security_rule_order.example :snippet::id
```

or

```bash
terraform import scm_security_rule_order.example ::device:id
```

**Note:** Please provide just one of folder, snippet, or device for the import command.
